title: The Signature Vision: Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0.

Signature link hulls program, charter one: master laser terminals at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale link logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate pointing accuracy systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First consumer link hulls terminals ship: laser terminals input
definition: 2030 milestone on the Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First consumer link hulls terminals ship: laser terminals input plus link logistics output in one wearable.

What must be true first: the laser terminals results have to replicate outside the lab, link logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and pointing accuracy operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed laser terminals demonstrations, link logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting pointing accuracy uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Simulates Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 63494 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where laser terminals monitoring, link logistics redundancy, or pointing accuracy maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Deep-Space Laser Comms 2.0 — next-gen laser links to deep space.

Phase 1 — Prove (laser terminals): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (link logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (pointing accuracy): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (photon counting): link hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and deep-space-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
